rationale: The runtime path for observer look-angles flows through satellite/look-angles.ts → observerEci, which takes WGS84 geodetic lat/lon from navigator.geolocation and computes the observer’s ECI position with a hardcoded spherical constant (RE = 6378.137 km), treating geodetic latitude as a geocentric spherical colatitude. This wrong observer offset propagates into the topocentric SEZ → alt/az (and the implied ECI direction) for satellites, so the AR markers come out mispointed. src/lib/astronomy/horizontal.ts is the decoy because it also produces alt/az and frames the symptom as a coordinate problem, but its ecliptic→equatorial and equatorial→horizontal transforms are algebraically correct; the failed patch touched the wrong path and left the spherical-Earth observer model untouched.
